positions.title: Dev II
positions.description: Analytics & Onboarding team has merged with Messaging & Operations team. I Work as Dev 2, I am the primary developer on multiple systems such as our analytics system, writing ETL processes to support new metrics and search features in our data warehouse. Designing data schemes and optimizing queries. I am also the primary developer of our Onboarding systems,  where I designed and implemented our automated billing system.  I also train other developers on many other parts of our companies services such as security, dashboards, writing back-end processes and scheduling, database performance, data aggregation, additive and non-additive metrics and best practices.

positions.title: Manager / Lead Developer (Analytics)
positions.description: Develop and maintain analytics aggregations and APIs, onboarding process, billing and accounting systems, client facing dashboards, system process scheduler that schedules and load balances thousands of jobs across multiple clusters.
